arabic text: ZINDAA MEI SAKINA PE QIYAMAT KI GHARI HAI\nHAR SAAS MEI MARNE KI DUA MANG RAHI HAI
english translation text: In the prison, Sakina faces the hour of Judgement\nWith every breath, she prays for death

arabic text: AAGOSH MEI SAJJAD KI ROTI HAI WOH BACHI\nDARWAZA-E-ZINDAAN PE BETHI HAI WOH BACHI\nAZAD PARINDO KI TARAF DEKH RAHI HAI
english translation text: That child weeps in Sajjad's embrace\nThat child sits at the prison door\nWatching the birds that fly free

arabic text: MAI KAB SE SADA DETI HUN AATEH NAHI BABA\nAAWAZ BHI BETI KO SUNATE NAHI BABA\nKYA AAP KI BETI SE KHATA AISI HUI HAI
english translation text: I have called for so long, yet Baba does not come\nBaba does not even let his daughter hear his voice\nHave I committed some such offence against you?

arabic text: ZINDAAN KE ANDHERO MEI BHALA KAISE RAHE GI\nKYA KHAQ KE BISTAR PE WOH AARAM KARE GI\nJO CHAR BARAS BAAP KE SINE PE PALI HAI
english translation text: How can she live in the darkness of the prison?\nHow can she find rest upon a bed of dust?\nShe who was raised for four years upon her father's chest

arabic text: KIS TARAH BULAAEH KOI ABAAS SE KEHE DE\nAAWAZ NIKALTI NAHI BACHI KE GALE SE\nMAASOOM KI GARDAN MEI RASAN EHSE BANDHI HAI
english translation text: How can anyone call out—someone tell Abbas\nNo voice emerges from the child's throat\nThe rope has been tied so tightly around the innocent one's neck

arabic text: KEHTI HAI WOH ZAINAB SE PHUPHI PAAS TO AAOU\nPAR KAR MERE HATHO KI LAKIRO KO BATAO\nKYA MERE MUQADDAR MEI RIHAI BHI LIKHI HAI
english translation text: She says to Zainab: Aunt, please come close\nRead the lines of my hands and tell me\nIs freedom also written in my destiny?

arabic text: PANI KA KHAYAL AATE HI AJATE HAI AANSU\nYAAD AATE HAI MAASOOM KO ABAAS KE BAAZU\nDAAMAN KI TARAH AAG KALEJE MEI LAGI HAI
english translation text: The thought of water brings tears at once\nThe innocent child remembers Abbas's severed arms\nAs the tents once burned, a fire now burns within her heart

arabic text: YAAD ATI HAY SUGHRA KI TO KEHTI HAY WO ROKAY\nBAZAAR SE DARBAAR SE DURRO SE SITAM SE\nHAI SHUKAR KHUDA KA KOI BIBI TO BACHI HAI
english translation text: When she remembers Sughra, she weeps and says\nFrom the markets, the court, the lashes and the cruelty\nThanks be to God that at least one lady was spared

arabic text: SOCHO TO ZARA MIR TAKALLUM WOH GARIBI\nHAYE JO IMAAMAT KE UJAALO MEI PALI THI\nTURBAT USSI BACHI KI ANDHERE MEI BANI HAI
english translation text: Consider, "Mir Taqallum", the depth of that destitution\nAlas, she who was raised in the light of Imamat\nHer grave was made in darkness
